source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: شتا من الشتوات، صحينا ولقينا الدنيا بيضا.
sentences.en: One winter, we woke up and found the world white.

sentences.ar: نزل تلج بالليل وغطى كل إشي.
sentences.en: Snow had fallen at night and covered everything.
The kids were very happy and ran to the garden.

sentences.ar: عملوا رجل تلج كبير وحطولوا جزرة.
sentences.en: They made a big snowman and gave it a carrot.
We threw snowballs at each other and laughed a lot.
My mom made us hot chocolate.
We sat around the heater to warm up.

sentences.ar: من الشباك، كنا نتفرج عالتلج ينزل.
sentences.en: From the window, we watched the snow fall.
It was a day we'll never forget.
